assets.name: stamp-monument-royal-glossy-v76
assets.title: Royal stamp monument (front)
assets.description: ROYAL PURPLE variant. A massive shiny purple mushroom-shaped hand grip with wide rounded cap and a small golden envelope medallion on its front. A tall elegant glossy warm ivory handle shaft with two broad shallow vertical grooves and two gold collars. A wide squat rectangular gold stamp head at the bottom, with a thick dark violet RUBBER pad clearly visible as a horizontal front band. Total height roughly 1.5 times base width. Original whimsical shape; not a literal stone column. Symmetric dignified pose.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production individual 2D scenery sprite for Magic Mail mobile puzzle map. The attached purple cottage is ONLY the required GLOSSY MATERIAL / COLOR / HIGHLIGHT reference, do NOT draw a house. Create ONE giant traditional HANDHELD RUBBER INK STAMP transformed into a MONUMENTAL roadside prop, filling the role that Greek columns fill in a whimsical game map. It MUST be recognizable as a hand stamp: a chunky upper hand grip, long narrow handle shaft, much wider heavy stamp head and distinct thick dark rubber stamping pad on the BOTTOM. NOT a postage-stamp paper rectangle, NOT a modern office self-inking machine, NOT an actual Greek column, not a building. Frontal elevation, perfectly straight on, orthographic, show only front surfaces; no side faces, no isometric view, no visible top floor plane. A completely STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL bottom foundation line so the lower stamp base can be partially buried evenly in grass. Full object with generous transparent margin. Extremely glossy rounded sculpted cartoon, saturated bright candy lacquer, chunky gold polished bevels, big white elongated specular patches on grip, shaft, base and medallion. Smooth broad reflection bands and dark rich colored contact shadows for real volume, matching the cottage and polished gold HUD. Everything glossy, no matte or painterly grain, no woodgrain, no dusty stone, no gritty damage, no heavy outer border. Big simple readable shapes for a phone map at 150 pixels. No text, no numbers, no scenery, no people, no ground patch, no floor, no exterior cast shadow, no glowing aura, no sparkles, no white sticker outline. Genuine transparent alpha background. assets.name: stamp-monument-curved-teal-glossy-v76
assets.title: Curved teal stamp monument (front)
assets.description: TURQUOISE CURVED variant. A wide rounded turquoise hand grip, like an inflated flat mushroom knob, one huge clean white reflection. Long playful handle shaft curves left in a gentle S, sculpted glossy turquoise lacquer with one gold neck ring. The broad rectangular lower stamp head and thick deep blue RUBBER stamping pad stay completely level on a horizontal baseline; only the HANDLE curves, not the base. A raised gold wax-seal sun emblem centered on the front gold head. Total height about 1.35 times base width. A distinctive leaning-looking prop to echo whimsical columns while reading unmistakably as a giant hand stamp.

assets.name: stamp-monument-christmas-glossy-v76
assets.title: Christmas stamp monument (front)
assets.description: CHRISTMAS RUBY variant. Tall rich ruby-red lacquered mushroom hand grip with a small polished gold envelope medallion, a tiny clump of three glossy emerald holly leaves and two red berries at upper corner. Handle shaft glossy ruby red with one creamy white spiral stripe and polished gold collars, long enough to evoke an ornamental pillar. Wide rounded rectangular gold lower stamp head with a raised ivory snowflake medallion on the front. Thick deep forest-green RUBBER stamping pad on the flat bottom. One small smooth pearly-white snow ledge at top of stamp head only, not snowy ground. Total height 1.55 times base width. Restrained 3-4 broad shapes, festive without tiny clutter.
